sections.title: Performance Analysis
sections.content:
This is a React Native / Expo app with mock data. There are no database queries, so N+1 query patterns do not apply to the current code. All other categories have real findings.

---

sections.title: A. `SmartSearchBar` — Component type recreated every render
B. `CartItemsSection` — Inline arrow functions break `memo` on list items
C. `ProfileScreen` — `iconBox()` and `items` arrays recreated every render
D. `AiChatbot` — Inline closures in suggestion chip lists
2. Memory Leak — `AiChatbot.pushMessage`
A. `AppText` — 8 independent `useMemo` calls for trivial style fragments
B. Inline style objects in list maps
C. `useThemeContext` fallback allocates new functions on every call
Summary Table
sections.content:
| # | Category | File | Severity | Fix |
|---|----------|------|----------|-----|
| 1 | Unnecessary re-render | `smart-search-bar.tsx:31` | **High** | Move `searchField` to module scope; extract `TextRenderer` as a stable component |
| 2 | Unnecessary re-render | `cart-items-section.tsx:35` | **Medium** | Move handlers into `CartItemCard`; use stable callback refs |
| 3 | Unnecessary re-render | `profile-screen.tsx:25` | **Medium** | Move static config outside; `useMemo` for items, `useCallback` for handlers |
| 4 | Unnecessary re-render | `ai-chatbot.tsx:289` | **Low** | `useCallback` for chip press handler |
| 5 | Memory leak | `ai-chatbot.tsx:91` | **Medium** | `isMountedRef` guard on async state updates |
| 6 | Redundant computation | `app-text.tsx:72` | **Low** | Consolidate 8 `useMemo` into one |
| 7 | Caching | `search-catalogue.tsx:73` | **Low** | Module-level style constants |
| 8 | Caching | `theme.context.tsx:58` | **Low** | Module-level `_noop` for fallback callbacks |
